   1 class_name CameraSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 var _positioned: bool = false
   5 
   6 func setup() -> void:
   7 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   8 
   9 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
  10 	return q.with_all([C_CameraTarget, C_Transform]).enabled()
  11 
  12 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  13 	if not is_instance_valid(runtime.camera):
  14 		return
  15 	for entity in entities:
  16 		if not entity.enabled:
  17 			continue
  18 		var target: C_CameraTarget = entity.get_component(C_CameraTarget)
  19 		if not target.enabled:
  20 			continue
  21 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
  22 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  23 		if body == null or not body.ready or (motion != null and motion.placement_pending):
  24 			continue
  25 		var transform: C_Transform = entity.get_component(C_Transform)
  26 		var bounds: Rect2 = runtime.room_bounds
  27 		var half: Vector2 = Vector2(640, 360)
  28 		var desired: Vector2 = transform.position + target.offset
  29 		desired.x = clampf(desired.x, bounds.position.x + half.x, maxf(bounds.position.x + half.x, bounds.end.x - half.x))
  30 		desired.y = clampf(desired.y, bounds.position.y + half.y, maxf(bounds.position.y + half.y, bounds.end.y - half.y))
  31 		var camera: Camera2D = runtime.camera
  32 		camera.limit_left = int(bounds.position.x)
  33 		camera.limit_top = int(bounds.position.y)
  34 		camera.limit_right = int(bounds.end.x)
  35 		camera.limit_bottom = int(bounds.end.y)
  36 		camera.position = desired if not _positioned else camera.position.lerp(desired, 1.0 - exp(-target.smoothing * delta))
  37 		camera.position.x = clampf(camera.position.x, bounds.position.x + half.x, maxf(bounds.position.x + half.x, bounds.end.x - half.x))
  38 		camera.position.y = clampf(camera.position.y, bounds.position.y + half.y, maxf(bounds.position.y + half.y, bounds.end.y - half.y))
  39 		camera.reset_smoothing()
  40 		_positioned = true
